title: A cleaner sign-in screen
summary: Keep sign-in focused on approved work email and Google, with a more deliberate Apple-style Google action.
changes: Night Roster keeps the two simple sign-in routes: approved work email and Google.
The Google action is centred and presented as one clear secondary sign-in choice.
Microsoft and Apple sign-in remain intentionally absent.
Authentication rules, access requests, roster permissions and shared data are unchanged.
